capabilities: create a snapshot of vault notes
open notes in random order for review
mark notes as reviewed or delete them
extras: Support for non-Markdown files is planned but not yet available; review status updates come via commands, ribbon icon, or status bar (desktop only).
motivation: The README's use case says: 'You have a lot of notes and you want to review/clear them.'
problem: Vaults accumulate many old notes with no way to systematically work through and clean them up one by one.
summary: Snapshot-based reviewer that marks all existing notes for review and opens them in random order one by one for triage.
